runtime.name: codex-cli
runtime.configuration: Generated poteto-mode, opening-a-pr, technical-writing, and unslop Skills in a disposable two-commit repository; user configuration and rules ignored; read-only sandbox; all runner outputs stored outside the repository.
runtime.permissionProfile: read-only sandbox with approval policy never

assertions.evidence: The root loaded the repository-generated poteto-mode router.
All workflow Skills came from the fixture and no installed cache was read.
The explicit ready-publication intent selected opening-a-pr.
opening-a-pr, technical-writing, and unslop were loaded and applied in order.
The root resolved the repository path, GitHub remote, main base, feature head, and ready status.
The exact commit range, one commit, complete diff, and two paths were inspected.
The root freshly ran the greeting test and captured exit 0, two passes, and zero failures.
The feature commit followed the baseline without rewriting history.
A conventional title and exact polished body with all required sections were returned.
Unknown scm.pull_requests triggered the declared briefing fallback.
The result provides one exact gh command with quoted values and a quoted heredoc fed through --body-file -.
No network, forge API, browser, or gh operation ran.
The result explicitly states publication did not occur and no PR URL exists.
No merge or monitoring operation ran.
All runner artifacts were external and strict git status remained empty.

limitations: This proves W1 fallback behavior only; forge authentication, remote head availability, actual ready-PR creation, and read-back remain unverified W4 work.
The exact command was intentionally not executed.
Unrelated Cloudflare MCP authentication warnings did not participate in the workflow.
